description:
Company Overview

At Fluency, we come together under two shared passions that drive our culture: the scaling of digital ad operations, and fostering a workplace environment rooted in open communication, inclusivity, and a growth-oriented mindset. These passions not only set us apart in the industry, but also fuel our collective drive to reshape the industry and reinvent ourselves along the way. We're not just revolutionizing the digital advertising horizon, we're shaping an organization where every member feels a sense of pride and is inspired to do their best work.

Team Overview

Fluency builds the Agentic Advertising Operating System. Our teams share two commitments: making advertising execution scale across every major channel without adding headcount, and running a workplace built on open communication, inclusivity, and a growth-oriented mindset. Product, engineering, and go-to-market teams work as one team to give advertisers agents they can trust with real budgets, and every team member has room to shape what we build next.

Product Overview

Fluency is the Agentic Advertising Operating System. It connects advertisers' operational systems directly to ad publishers and automates campaign execution across walled gardens, the open web, and every major channel and DSP, from setup and launch through budget pacing and unified reporting. Agents take on pacing updates and campaign optimizations while human teams stay in control, and everything runs through Fluency's deterministic system so campaigns execute exactly as intended. Agencies and in-house teams trust Fluency to manage $3 billion in annual ad spend.

Job Summary

The Staff Product Manager, Social Ads owns the strategy, architecture, and execution of Fluency’s paid social channel and the underlying platform capabilities—data processing engines, automation workflows, and publisher APIs—that power campaign execution across major social platforms (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snap, Pinterest, and emerging walled gardens).

At this level, you frame problems that arrive undefined, spot gaps in the plan that nobody has named yet, and shape decisions beyond your immediate squad. You model the economics of your scope, hold your own in deep architectural discussions with senior and principal engineers, and lead through influence rather than formal authority.

You partner closely with Engineering, Product Working Groups (PWGs), Partner Relations, Client Services, Sales, and Product Marketing to take capabilities from initial technical concept through Alpha, Beta, and General Availability—ensuring high reliability, throughput, and developer/partner ecosystem readiness.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Shape the multi-quarter vision and product strategy for Fluency’s Social Ads channel and core platform infrastructure, contributing to broader platform-level strategy across channels.
  • Own the roadmap and backlog for paid social integrations and foundational platform capabilities, sequencing priorities across squads and resolving cross-team conflicts with clear, documented trade-offs.
  • Own end-to-end publisher API integrations and technical partner relationships across major social platforms—managing roadmap access, alpha/beta participation, API version migrations, and technical escalations.
  • Establish and enforce structured decision frameworks for scoping, prioritization, and balancing new feature delivery against platform scalability, reliability, and technical debt reduction.
  • Model the unit economics of your scope—including infrastructure cost to serve, API throughput efficiency, and margin impact—and partner on packaging and pricing proposals with supporting analysis.
  • Author crisp, high-leverage briefs and Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for multi-squad capabilities, documenting high-stakes architectural and product trade-offs so the reasoning endures.
  • Own the product side of evaluation frameworks, deterministic guardrails, and autonomy boundaries for agentic social campaign setup, pacing, and optimization.
  • Lead your Product Working Group (PWG) across Engineering, QA, Design, Client Services, and Sales, proactively surfacing technical bottlenecks and dependency risks before they stall delivery.
  • Own release readiness across Alpha, Beta, and GA stages—enforcing strict entry/exit criteria and ensuring API documentation, CS/Support training, and Sales enablement are ready before launch.
  • Define the measurement model for your scope—separating adoption from delivered customer value—and use system performance metrics and post-launch triage to guide iteration or retire underperforming investments.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, and Client Services on positioning, go-to-market launches, and strategic customer escalations, resolving recurring workflow friction at its source.
  • Mentor Product Managers and Senior PMs across the organization and raise the bar on how the product discipline operates.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8–10+ years of product management experience, with a strong emphasis on B2B SaaS platforms, backend architecture, high-throughput data pipelines, or API-driven systems.
  • 5+ years building digital advertising or ad-tech products with deep familiarity across paid social platforms (e.g., Meta Marketing API, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snap) and walled-garden campaign mechanics.
  • Proven ownership of a platform capability or channel that spanned multiple engineering squads, with measurable commercial or operational outcomes attached to it.
  • Direct experience managing technical relationships with third-party ad platforms or ecosystem partners that unlocked beta access, API capabilities, or roadmap influence.
  • Track record of framing ambiguous problems into a clear, multi-quarter strategy adopted by peers and executive leadership.
  • Commercial fluency: experience anchoring technical and roadmap investments to unit economics, infrastructure cost efficiency, margins, and packaging/pricing decisions.
  • Architectural depth to challenge engineering proposals on product grounds—including API design, data models, throughput, and system reliability.
  • Experience defining evaluation criteria, guardrails, and reliability standards for AI- or agent-driven automation.
  • High operational rigor around release readiness, launch gates (Alpha/Beta/GA), documentation, and cross-functional enablement.
  • Strong analytical skills; you build clear measurement models and use post-launch telemetry and customer feedback to iterate or sunset features.
  • Experience leading cross-functional Product Working Groups (PWGs), partnering with Product Marketing on positioning and GTM execution, and mentoring other PMs.
  • Clear, direct written and verbal communication—equally effective in technical architecture reviews, executive strategy sessions, and strategic customer conversations—with comfort operating at high autonomy. 

Fluency pays all employees based on U.S. nationwide averages for each role, designed to ensure pay equity. This is a full-time, remote position that requires legal authorization to work in the U.S. Starting pay range is determined by job-related skills, experience, and knowledge. The role is also eligible for a discretionary bonus, equity options, and a comprehensive benefits package including:

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and their families
• 401(k) plan with company match
• Four weeks of Combined Time Off (CTO), flexible schedule, and twelve holidays
• Maternity and parental leave
• Employee wellness programs and mental health support
• Remote work flexibility and home office stipends

Starting Pay Range
$143,000—$164,000 USD

At Fluency, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and identities and do not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Employment decisions at Fluency are made based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications—without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local laws.
